snippet.title: Northgale Official Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist Northgale on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4056820  

Harness the power of the Northern Wind in Northgale, a cozy, physics-based exploration adventure.
Glide through a hand-painted Nordic world, master the art of kite-gliding, 
and discover hidden gnomes in this peaceful indie journey.
If you enjoyed games like A Short Hike, Sable, or Sky: Children of the Light, Northgale is built for you.

About the Game: 
Northgale is an atmospheric exploration game where you play as a young girl wielding the north wind itself through your kite.
Use wind currents to soar over pine forests, ancient ruins, and rushing waterfalls. 
Discover new abilities that allow you to reach higher peaks and uncover the secrets of the North.

Key Features: 
🪁 Unique physics-based kite gliding mechanics. 
🌲 Beautiful, stylized Nordic-folk aesthetic. 
🍄 Hidden gnomes and collectibles to find. 
🎶 A relaxing, atmospheric soundtrack.

Follow the Journey: 
🔹 Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/myteinteractive.bsky.social 
🔹 Discord: https://discord.gg/SYND4QeJ6p 
🔹 Website: https://myteinteractive.no/en/northgale

#Northgale #CozyGames #IndieDev #Exploration #Gaming #WholesomeGames #KiteGliding
